capabilities: Upload pasted or dropped images to a chosen public GitHub repository and branch
Insert public links in raw.githubusercontent.com, jsDelivr CDN, or custom URL format
Connect a GitHub account via device flow or a fine-grained personal access token
Upload all locally referenced images in a note and rewrite their links
Fall back to a local vault embed when an upload fails
extras: Not yet in the community plugin browser; must be installed manually from release files. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Browser-flow access expires after eight hours but renews itself for six months.
motivation: Existing image-upload plugins require installing a separate desktop app or manually creating and pasting a token; the author wanted setup with no token creation, via GitHub's device flow.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted images as binary attachments inside the vault, which the author wants to avoid by hosting images externally in a repository the user controls.

relations.evidence: uploads images to a GitHub repository as you paste them

requires.name: GitHub account with a public repository you can push to

summary: Image uploader that sends pasted or dropped images to a public GitHub repository and inserts a public link into the note.
